title: Entro Crystals
description:
Welcome to Extended AE! To start in this mod, you'll need a new type of resource, Entro Crystals. Craft an Entro Seed and click it on a Fluix Block: this will create a Budding Block that grows them. Growth Accelerators work!

There is no Flawless version of this, unfortunately, but you will get a way to prevent the decay down the line (@see Crystal Fixer)
